elevate.move: Change scale once: add a macro beat where the drawn language zooms to material (a shutter hinge or a bead-board strip at 1:1 with a brush stroke) between the second street and the marsh house, so the system escalates street -> house -> detail instead of repeating one elevation nine times.

Bring the second street alive: houses rise onto the ground line with a stagger on scroll-in, and on hover or focus each house's job happens (ladder leans in, gate rust clears, shutters open, mildew sprays off); give the piazza a completion beat when coat two lands (fan turns once, plaque flips to 'Clean two summers').
